subject: Inbound demo — TidalWave systems: multi-role scheduling & IT on-call
body:
From: TidalWave Lead Capture <no-reply@redwood.com>
To: jasmine_liu@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 01 Oct 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: New demo signup — TidalWave Systems (Warm lead)

Hi Jasmine,

A new self-serve demo signup just landed. Details attached to the lead in HubSpot.
Lead name: Danielle Parker
Company: TidalWave Systems
Role: Product Ops
Preferred times: "late mornings PT or early afternoons ET"
Notes: Wants SE/IT on call for security/network questions.

---

On Fri, 01 Oct 2027 at 16:04:12 -0700 Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com> wrote:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
To: Danielle Parker <d.parker@tidalwave.io>
Cc: soojin_lee@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 1 Oct 2027 16:04:12 -07:00
Subject: Re: New demo signup — quick availability + IT on-call?

Hi Danielle — thanks for signing up and for the heads-up about IT/security. I can run the product walkthrough (20 minutes) and loop in our SE for the technical segment (15 minutes).

Ava (AE) and Karthik (SE) are on copy — they’re my suggested participants. Can you confirm who from your side will join (product + IT contact)? Also, which timezone should we anchor to (you mentioned ET/ PT windows) so I can propose concrete slots?

Quick proposed windows (all PT):
- Mon Oct 4 — 11:00–11:45 PT
- Tue Oct 5 — 10:30–11:15 PT
- Wed Oct 6 — 12:30–13:15 PT

If none of those work I can pivot to afternoons ET. I’ll also attach a short IT checklist for anything your network team might want ahead of time.

Thanks — Jasmine
--
Jasmine Liu | SDR, Redwood Inference
jasmine_liu@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0147

Attachment: Prelim-IT-Checklist.pdf (stub: 1 page)

---

On Fri, 01 Oct 2027 at 17:02:08 -04:00 Danielle Parker <d.parker@tidalwave.io> wrote:
From: Danielle Parker <d.parker@tidalwave.io>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
Cc: Matt Chen <m.chen@tidalwave.io>
Date: Fri, 1 Oct 2027 17:02:08 -04:00
Subject: Re: New demo signup — quick availability + IT on-call?

Thanks, Jasmine — appreciate the fast follow. I’ll be on the call; Matt (IT) will join for the security questions. We’re based on ET.

Of the proposed options, Tue Oct 5 at 10:30 PT works best for me (that’s 13:30 ET). Can you hold that? If possible, we’d like the SE to be present for KV cache/tenant isolation questions.

Also — are there any simple network or firewall rules we should share with Matt ahead of time? He’s copied.

Cheers,
Danielle

---

On Fri, 01 Oct 2027 at 17:24:37 -07:00 Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com> wrote:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
To: Danielle Parker <d.parker@tidalwave.io>
Cc: ava_chen@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, soojin_lee@redwood.com, Matt Chen <m.chen@tidalwave.io>
Date: Fri, 1 Oct 2027 17:24:37 -07:00
Subject: Re: New demo signup — quick availability + IT on-call?

Great — locking in Tue Oct 5 10:30 PT / 13:30 ET for a 35-minute walkthrough (20m product + 15m SE Q&A). Ava and Karthik — can you confirm availability? Karthik, please be ready to cover tenant isolation, KV cache behavior in multi-tenant setups, and any firewall outbound ports we recommend.

Matt — attaching the short firewall/network checklist. Short answer: outbound HTTPS to our hosted control plane + a potential lightweight SSH jump for on-prem installs (we can avoid if you get us IP allowlist). Full details in the attachment.

If anyone needs a different slot we can swap — let me know by EOD Monday.

Thanks — Jasmine

Attachment: Demo-Agenda-v2.md (stub: agenda + meeting link)

---

On Fri, 01 Oct 2027 at 20:12:10 -07:00 karthik_iyer@redwood.com wrote:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>, ava_chen@redwood.com
Cc: soojin_lee@redwood.com, Danielle Parker <d.parker@tidalwave.io>, Matt Chen <m.chen@tidalwave.io>
Date: Fri, 1 Oct 2027 20:12:10 -07:00
Subject: Re: New demo signup — quick availability + IT on-call?

Thanks for the heads up. I’m tentatively free at that time — will block my calendar and plan to cover tenant isolation, cache behavior for long-running sessions, and recommended IP ranges.

Two quick asks for Matt before the demo to make the Q&A efficient:
- Can you confirm whether TidalWave runs an outbound proxy that performs TLS inspection? If yes, we’ll need whitelisting for our OCSP/CRL endpoints.
- Do you prefer a short network diagram or a checklist? I can prepare either; checklists are quicker.

I’ll be on the bridge early to validate screen-sharing and the demo environment.

— Karthik

---

On Mon, 04 Oct 2027 at 09:05:00 -04:00 Danielle Parker <d.parker@tidalwave.io> wrote:
From: Danielle Parker <d.parker@tidalwave.io>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>, ava_chen@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: Matt Chen <m.chen@tidalwave.io>, soojin_lee@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 4 Oct 2027 09:05:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: New demo signup — quick availability + IT on-call?

Sorry — small change on our side. Matt is on an on-call rotation and a critical incident might overlap with Tue Oct 5 at 13:30 ET. Can we move to Wed Oct 6 at 11:00 ET instead? That’s 08:00 PT for your team.

If Karthik or Ava can’t make 08:00 PT we can also do Wed Oct 6 at 14:00 ET (11:00 PT). Let me know what works and we’ll lock it.

Thanks,
Danielle

---

On Mon, 04 Oct 2027 at 10:02:41 -07:00 Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com> wrote:
From: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: Danielle Parker <d.parker@tidalwave.io>, Matt Chen <m.chen@tidalwave.io>, soojin_lee@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 4 Oct 2027 10:02:41 -07:00
Subject: Re: New demo signup — quick availability + IT on-call?

I can make Wed Oct 6 at 08:00 PT work, Karthik? That’s early but doable. Karthik — if you can’t, we’ll take the 11:00 PT slot instead.

If we go 08:00 PT I’ll shorten the product segment to 15 minutes so the SE Q&A can be longer. Danielle — does 11:00 ET still cover the stakeholders you need?

Ava
--
Ava Chen | Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ava_chen@redwood.com | +1 650-555-0192

---

On Mon, 04 Oct 2027 at 10:22:09 -07:00 karthik_iyer@redwood.com wrote:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
Cc: Danielle Parker <d.parker@tidalwave.io>, Matt Chen <m.chen@tidalwave.io>, soojin_lee@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 4 Oct 2027 10:22:09 -07:00
Subject: Re: New demo signup — quick availability + IT on-call?

I’m good for Wed Oct 6 at 08:00 PT — I’ll plan roughly 25 minutes for SE-level discussion and leave 10–15 minutes for immediate follow-ups.

Matt — quick confirmation: please review the attached checklist and flag if you need a short network diagram instead. If you can confirm outbound proxy/TLS inspection and any IP ranges by EOD Tue it’ll let me tailor the demo environment.

See you all on Wed.

— Karthik

---

On Tue, 05 Oct 2027 at 08:50:00 -07:00 Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com> wrote:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
To: Danielle Parker <d.parker@tidalwave.io>, Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Matt Chen <m.chen@tidalwave.io>, soojin_lee@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 5 Oct 2027 08:50:00 -07:00
Subject: Final confirmation — Wed Oct 6 08:00 PT / 11:00 ET

Thanks everyone — Wed Oct 6 08:00 PT / 11:00 ET is locked for 35 minutes. Meeting link and agenda are in HubSpot and the calendar invite.

Agenda (brief):
- 0–15m: Product walkthrough (Ava)
- 15–35m: SE deep-dive & Q&A (Karthik)
- Action items: follow-up security doc and preliminary POC checklist

If your IT team needs to join early for network validation we can open the bridge 10 minutes prior.

See you Wednesday — Jasmine

--
Thread metadata: this thread represents a warm inbound converted to a multi-role scheduled demo; internal participants are SDR (Jasmine), AE (Ava), SE (Karthik), and SDR support (Soojin).
